chunks: He said: It is narrated from Sulaiman ibn Dawood from Ali ibn Abi Hamza from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said,

He said to me: O Ali, whoever informs you that he was at my bedside in my illness, closed my eyes, washed me, placed me in my grave niche, and shook the dust from his hand from my grave, do not believe him.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Kadhim (a.s.) say about those who claim to have seen him die and be buried?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Ghayba* serves as a critical refutation of the *Waqifiya* sect, who claimed Imam Musa al-Kadim (a.s.) died and were buried in a known location. The Imam clarifies that his death and burial were concealed to prevent enemies from desecrating his grave or establishing a false locus of worship, thereby preserving the authenticity of his occultation (*Ghayba*). This narrative underscores the Shia belief that the Imam’s physical presence was hidden from public view, distinguishing true Shia tradition from those who fixed his death to a specific, visible tomb.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 49 - It is narrated from Sulaiman bin Dawood from Ali bin Abi Hamza that he said:
Imam Kadhim (a.s) said: O Ali, if someone informs you that he was at my bedside in my illness and after my death, he saw me with my eyes closed and took part in my funeral, you must not believe him.
